hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; command -v mise >/dev/null && eval "$(mise env -s bash)"; file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$file" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs|*.json|*.css|*.md|*.mdx|*.yml) pnpm exec oxfmt --write "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; jq -e '.stop_hook_active' >/dev/null && exit 0; command -v mise >/dev/null && eval "$(mise env -s bash)"; files=$(git status --porcelain | awk '{print $NF}' | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs)$' | while read -r f; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "$f"; done); report=$( { pnpm -s typecheck && { [ -z "$files" ] || pnpm exec oxlint --deny-warnings $files; }; } 2>&1 ) && exit 0; jq -n --arg why "$(printf '%s' "$report" | tail -40)" '{decision: "block", reason: ("Typecheck or lint fails on the changed files. Fix it before stopping:\n" + $why)}'
